value.rationale: The literature supplies sharp constants for finite exponents and at infinity but lacks their quantitative interpolation. The coefficient 16pi^2(3-v_*^2) is the exact endpoint stability-gap convergence invariant, identifying different localization codimensions and a nontrivial log(q)/q rate. Its full order-q^{-1} intercept can be used to assess finite-exponent stability estimates and distinguishes a true global sharp gap from a mere single Bessel integral. This is a motivated complete asymptotic classification of the canonical three-dimensional problem, not an arbitrary finite sample or a tiny improvement.
